title: Fit13
desc: A figure in motion, hidden inside the number 13

blocks.title: Fit13
blocks.lede: A figure in motion, hidden inside the number 13.

items.label: Role
items.value: Logotype, identity system, collateral, logo animation

items.label: Scope
items.value: Mark construction, identity, social, signage, animation

items.statement: Fitness branding has a very small vocabulary.
body: Neon. Shouting. “Push harder.” Everything tries to motivate so aggressively that it starts looking like background noise.
Fit13 needed strength without the performance of strength.
The number 13 became the starting point. While exploring its construction, I found enough space inside the numeral to hide a human figure in motion.

blocks.text: Energy from construction, not from effects.

body: The system extends across social, apparel and signage, including a wall-scale application. The logo animation keeps the same construction rule in motion instead of inventing a second idea.

items.statement: Fit13 gets energy without looking like another motivational gym brand.
body: And there is a broader design principle behind it: the strongest concept doesn’t always need to sit on top of the design. Sometimes it should be hiding inside it.
